title: PNP: US authorities reach out amid Thomas Markle child abuse probe

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Tuesday confirmed that United States authorities, including the Federal Bureau of Investigation, had reached out amid investigation into the alleged child abuse materials recovered from a foreign national. PNP spokesperson Col. Allen Co said that the US counterpart initiated communications with them in connection with the child sexual abuse images and exploitation discovered from the electronic devices owned by Thomas Markle Sr., the estranged father of Meghan Markle, the Duchess of Sussex. “They have expressed their readiness to extend assistance should we require their support in the course of the investigation,” Co […]...
